_doc: Reference data for benchmarking the Castor pipeline against a B2B SaaS cyber-insurance + risk-monitoring platform for SMBs.

venture_under_test.name: Bulwark
venture_under_test.description: Bulwark is a B2B SaaS cyber-insurance + active-risk-monitoring platform for SMBs with 50-500 employees. We bundle cyber-insurance underwriting, continuous attack-surface monitoring, employee phishing-simulation training, and incident-response retainer. Pricing: insurance premium calculated per-policy + $80 per employee per year for the monitoring + training package. Target buyer: COO, CFO, or Director of IT/Security at SMBs without a dedicated CISO. We compete with Coalition, At-Bay, Resilience, Vouch, and Cowbell. Differentiation: insurance premium discounts auto-applied when monitoring detects + remediates risks (vs static annual policy renewals), bundled MDR (managed detection + response) for sub-CISO companies, and continuous compliance posture mapping for SOC2/HIPAA/PCI.
venture_under_test.category: B2B SaaS cyber-insurance / SMB risk monitoring

expected_pipeline_outputs._tam_note: Defensible US SMB cyber-insurance + monitoring scoping: narrow $0.8-1.5B (50-500 emp ICP × monitoring tier only), mid-narrow $2.5-4B (US SMB cyber-insurance premium total), broad $7-9B (US cyber-insurance + adjacent risk-monitoring software). Pipeline TAM mid acceptable in $0.8B-$9B range.
